verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Workflows, its own feature for automating machine learning tasks as pipelines on GPU instances, which is a first-party automation capability. The evidence is a single overview sentence, though, and says nothing about schedules, triggers or unattended background running; auto-shutdown is only an adjacent idle control. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules or event triggers, evidence that workflows run unattended in the background, in-depth workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows automate machine learning tasks, combining GPU instances with an expressive syntax to generate production-ready machine learning pipelines with a few lines of code.
